q_en:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:
Some biscuits are chocolates.
All chocolates are nuts.
No nut is a pastry.

Conclusions:
(I) No pastry is a biscuit.
(II) Some nuts are biscuits.

In a certain code language,
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,
‘A – B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’,
‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and
‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.
How is M related to J if ‘M + N × L ÷ J – K’?
5614

In a certain code language,
‘A & B’ means ‘A is the son of B’
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’
‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’
‘A - B’ means ‘A is the father of B’
Based on the above, how is A related to M if ‘A ÷ D @ G & K - M’?

Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question. Counting to be done from left to right. All numbers are single-digit numbers.
(Left) T % 7 D @ 6 K P C % Y # * E 4 @ & 2 R M # * S (Right)
How many such symbols are there each of which is immediately preceded by a letter and also immediately followed by a number?
In a certain code language, DSIP is coded as 71 and YLCV  is coded as 57. What is the code for MBJE in the given language?

P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Q is sitting third to the right of V. U is sitting to the immediate left of Q. T is sitting second to the right of U. P is sitting second to the left of R. How many people are sitting between Q and S when counted from the left of S?

This question is based on the following words
(Left) LAG WAX HIP EGG (Right)
How many letters are there in the English alphabetical order between second letter of first word from the right and second letter of first word from the left?

Based on the alphabetical order three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that does NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their positions in the letter-cluster.)5302

In each of the words, each vowel is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter-clusters thus formed, will no vowel appear?

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.
R has exam on Tuesday. Only one person has exam between R and P. Q has exam on the day immediately before T but not on Friday. Only two people have exams between S and Q. V does not have exam on Friday.
How many people have exams between R and Q?5636

Both conclusions I and II are true.
q_en:
In this question, a statement is followed by two conclusions, numbered I and II. Find which conclusion is true based on the given statements.

Statement: A > B = C ≤ D < E > F
Conclusions:
I. A > F
II. D = B5392

K, L, P, Q, W and X live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor, which is numbered 6. Only W lives above X. Only two people lives between P and K. L lives on an even-numbered floor. P lives on the lowermost floor. How many people live between Q and W?5278

R travelled on the day immediately before Q. Only two people travelled between T and Q. T travelled on Monday. S travelled on the day immediately before V but not on Friday. Only two people travelled between U and P. P did not travel immediately after Q.
Following a certain logic, T is related to Wednesday in the given arrangement in the same way as Q is related to Saturday. To which of the following days is R related to following the same logic? 5645
